Device Info X reads your device\'s hardware and software details — CPU, memory, battery, display, network, sensors, and camera — entirely on-device. There\'s no account, no backend, and no analytics or crash reporting; network, location, and Bluetooth permissions are only requested from the Network screen, and only used to show that data back to you.
Device Info X is built using world-class open-source software. Below is a list of the libraries and tools that make this app possible.

Enter your code backwards at the lock screen to trigger a silent wipe. It looks and behaves exactly like a wrong code — same error, same lockout — but your private data on this device is deleted in the background.\n\nThis only works if your code isn\'t a palindrome (the same both ways). Nothing changes on the server, so unlocking normally afterward re-syncs everything automatically.
